name: Instant Chat Assistant
author: abdullahart

sections.description:
Quick Chat Bot is an AI-powered chatbot plugin that helps your website visitors find answers quickly and efficiently.
It’s easy to use, customizable, and integrates seamlessly with your WordPress site.

Notes

For support, please visit [your support URL here].
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org te.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ using an FTP client or the WordPress Plugin Installer.
  3. Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Use the shortcode [quick_chat] to display the chatbot on any page or post.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support multilingual websites?

Yes, Quick Chat Bot supports WPML and Polylang for multilingual functionality.

Can I customize the chatbot responses?

Yes, the chatbot responses can be customized via the plugin settings.

Is this plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, Quick Chat Bot is fully responsive and works on all devices.
